{"metadata":{"description":"Bridge Google AI subscription (Antigravity/Gemini OAuth) into DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint","id":"gh:1355522360","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge","slug":"hyqhyq3/dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge","topics":["antigravity","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","gemini","google","oauth","openai-compatible"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Bridge Google AI subscription (Antigravity/Gemini OAuth) into DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatib"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"le AI subscription (Antigravity/Gemini OAuth) into DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-gemini-oauth-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Bridges a **Google AI subscription** (AI Pro / AI Ultra, via the Antigravity / Code Assist OAuth sur"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"face) into an **OpenAI-compatible endpoint** that DeepSeek Harness (DSH) can use directly as a model"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" an **OpenAI-compatible endpoint** that DeepSeek Harness (DSH) can use directly as a model provider."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Important boundary**: Google AI subscription developer quotas only cover the AI Studio web UI an"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"d OAuth login inside official CLI tools (Gemini CLI / Antigravity); **API-key usage is billed separa"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"tely**. This plugin speaks the same OAuth surface as the official client, so it consumes subscriptio"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"n quota rather than API credit — but that also means it is not a Google-sanctioned third-party integ"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ration. Account risk / breakage is possible; evaluate for yourself."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Login and go**: one-click Google OAuth from Settings → Gemini OAuth (authorization code + loopba"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ck callback), with automatic `loadCodeAssist` registration / `onboardUser` onboarding and upstream m"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"odel discovery.
- **OpenAI-compatible endpoint**: `/gemini-oauth-bridge/v1/chat/completions` (stream"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ing SSE + non-streaming) and `/v1/models` (so DSH can discover models).
- **Full protocol translatio"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"n**: system messages, multimodal (data-URL images), function calling (tool_calls ↔ functionCall/func"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"tionResponse), `reasoning_content` (thinking stream), usage stats, finish-reason mapping.
- **Gemini"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" 3 thought-signature replay**: the server remembers upstream `thoughtSignature` values by tool-call "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"id and re-attaches them to functionCall parts on the next turn — OpenAI format carries no signatures"},{"id":"p7s9","text":", and Gemini 3 multi-turn tool calls fail without replay.
- **Subscription-friendly (anti-drift)**: "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"dynamically tracks the latest shipping Antigravity client version for the User-Agent (stale versions"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" are rejected for newer models); requests carry `requestType: "agent"`, a stable derived `sessionId`"},{"id":"p7s12","text":", and `agent-<uuid>` request IDs; keep-alive connections without `Connection: close`.
- **429 cooldo"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"wns**: parses upstream `Retry-After` / `retryDelay`, enters a per-model cooldown window, and refuses"},{"id":"p7s14","text":" requests locally during it instead of hammering upstream.
- **Catalog honesty**: an entry the upstr"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"eam catalog flags `disabled: true` — e.g. `gemini-4-argon-disabled` ("Unavailable" / "available to U"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ltra and paid Pro plan subscribers") — is never published as a DSH model, so the picker cannot offer"},{"id":"p7s17","text":" something that can only fail. A request for an id the account cannot use returns the upstream's own"},{"id":"p7s18","text":" explanation plus a refresh hint instead of an opaque `404 Requested entity was not found`. Per-mode"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"l context/output limits are read from the upstream `maxTokens` / `maxOutputTokens` fields.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Restart `dsh --profile web`, then open Settings → **Gemini OAuth**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. Click **登录 Google 账号** (Log in with Google) and finish the flow in your browser. The plugin tempo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rarily listens on `127.0.0.1:51121` for the loopback callback — this exact redirect URI is registere"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d for the Antigravity client and the port cannot change. Port conflicts are reported explicitly.
2. "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"After login the page shows the account, project ID, tier, and model list.
3. Register the bridge as "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"a DSH provider in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (port matches your DSH web URL, default 3080):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Local state"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` (mode 0600, contains OAuth tokens — treat as a secret):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Field | Meaning |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `tokens` | access/refresh tokens and expiry |
| `email` / `project` / `tier` | login account and r"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"egistration result |
| `models` | upstream model cache (refreshable from the UI) |
| `modelCaps` | p"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"er-model `contextLength` / `maxCompletionTokens` read from the upstream catalog |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- OAuth tokens live in `~/.dsh/gemini-oauth-bridge.json` (mode 0600) and are never returned by any e"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ndpoint; `/api/status` exposes only account metadata (email, project, tier) and the model list.
- DS"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"H applies a Host/Origin fence to its own `/api/*` routes, but a plugin `webServer.register({kind: 'p"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"refix'})` route is dispatched before that fence, so the bridge enforces the same rules itself: a req"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"uest is refused with 403 when its `Host` is not an authority the bridge serves, when `Sec-Fetch-Site"},{"id":"p20s6","text":": cross-site`, when `Origin` is the opaque `null` a sandboxed frame sends, when `Origin` disagrees w"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ith `Host`, or when a request arrives with no `Host` at all from anything other than a loopback peer"},{"id":"p20s8","text":". This blocks DNS-rebinding reads of `/api/status` and `/v1/*`, quota-burning calls through `/v1/cha"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"t/completions`, and blind-CSRF of the mutating POSTs (`/api/login`, `/api/logout`, `/api/refresh-mod"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"els`) — a cross-site `Content-Type: text/plain` POST needs no CORS preflight, so without the fence t"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"he browser would deliver it.
- `/v1/*` is unauthenticated by default because DSH calls it locally; s"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"et `"apiKey"` in the state file to require `Authorization: Bearer <value>`, and `"trustedHosts": ["h"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"ost:port"]` to serve DSH on a non-loopback address."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Unofficial usage**: relies on the Antigravity client's public OAuth credentials and a non-public"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" `v1internal` surface; Google may change or restrict it at any time. Intended for individual subscri"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"bers' own use.
- Single account (no rotation); `http(s)://` image URLs unsupported (data URLs only);"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" the signature cache is persisted but LRU-evicts past 800 entries.
- The login callback occupies `12"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"7.0.0.1:51121`; logging in while the Antigravity desktop app is also logging in may conflict.
- Gene"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ration goes to the `daily-cloudcode-pa` channel (matching CLIProxyAPI's default); override via `apiC"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"onfig` if needed.
- **Some catalog models cannot generate.** Upstream advertises entries it will not"},{"id":"p22s8","text":" serve for your account — the Gemini 4 Argon family appears only as `gemini-4-argon-disabled` with `"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"disabled: true`, `tagTitle: "Unavailable"` and `tagDescription: "Gemini 4 Argon is currently availab"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"le to Ultra and paid Pro plan subscribers."`, and every id variant returns `404 NOT_FOUND` even on a"},{"id":"p22s11","text":" paid `g1-pro-tier` (Google AI Pro) account. Catalog membership is therefore not proof that a model "},{"id":"p22s12","text":"can generate; the plugin hides `disabled` entries, but no client-side change can enable them."}],"truncated":true}
